Court Delays

Again, public defenders are busy. This means that they are going to have little time for court hearings. This also means that your hearing could be delayed. This is not something that you want to hear because this means that you could be sitting in jail longer. 

Busy People

When you are appointed a public defender, they are going to be very busy with many cases. Often, public defenders will carry more cases than a privately hired attorney. 

Public Defender

As you know, public defenders are not bad people. However, they may not be as great as you think. They do have some cons. There are attorneys available for hire as well. Public defenders are great for experience and knowledge. They also know what is best because they know the local laws surrounding the case.

John Collins

Private Criminal Defense Attorney

The new common language will be more simple and regular than the existing European languages. Europe uses the same vocabulary.
  • The European languages are members of the same family. Their separate existence is a myth. For science, music, sport, etc.
  • Europe uses the same vocabulary.
  • The languages only differ in their grammar, their pronunciation and their most common words. The European languages are members of the same family.
If several languages coalesce, the grammar of the resulting language is more simple and regular than that of the individual languages. The new common language will be more simple and regular than the existing European languages. Europe uses the same vocabulary.

Breaking Down Employment Law

The languages only differ in their grammar, their pronunciation and their most common words. Everyone realizes why a new common language would be desirable: one could refuse to pay expensive translators.
  • To achieve this, it would be necessary to have uniform grammar, pronunciation and more common words.
  • If several languages coalesce, the grammar of the resulting language is more simple and regular than that of the individual languages.
The new common language will be more simple and regular than the existing European languages. It will be as simple as Occidental.

Practical and Useful: Knowledge of the Laws

To achieve this, it would be necessary to have uniform grammar, pronunciation and more common words. If several languages coalesce, the grammar of the resulting language is more simple and regular than that of the individual languages.

The new common language will be more simple and regular than the existing European languages. It will be as simple as Occidental; in fact, it will be Occidental. To an English person, it will seem like simplified English, as a skeptical Cambridge friend of mine told me what Occidental is.The European languages are members of the same family. Their separate existence is a myth.

For science, music, sport, etc, Europe uses the same vocabulary. The languages only differ in their grammar, their pronunciation and their most common words. Everyone realizes why a new common language would be desirable: one could refuse to pay expensive translators. To achieve this, it would be necessary to have uniform grammar, pronunciation and more common words. If several languages coalesce, the grammar of the resulting language is more simple.
Complicated Case

When it comes to a public defender, you are talking about those that are appointed to you. There are attorneys available for hire as well. These are often good people who just want to protect those who are innocent. However, there are the few who are there to obtain money. 

Fraud Scheme

Fraud is on the rise globally: according to a 2022 PwC study, 51% of surveyed organizations experience fraud in the past two years, the highest level in 20 years of research.

 

Abuse Victims

“Victims” means persons who, individually or collectively, have suffered harm, including physical or mental injury, emotional suffering, economic loss or substantial impairment of their fundamental rights, through acts.

Real Estate Fraud

There are countless types of fraud schemes – countless ways a fraudster can scam a person or a business out of money or other assets. In the case of many common fraud schemes, the crime can be internal, external, or collusion.

Discrimination Case

The law which says you mustn’t be discriminated against is called the Equality Act 2010. Discrimination which is against the Act is unlawful. If you’ve experienced unlawful discrimination, you can take action about it under the Act.

Fraud is on the rise globally: according to a 2022 PwC study, 51% of surveyed organizations experience fraud in the past two years, the highest level in 20 years of research.

 

","_id":"9948ec9"},{"toggle_title":"Abuse Victims","toggle_content":"

"Victims" means persons who, individually or collectively, have suffered harm, including physical or mental injury, emotional suffering, economic loss or substantial impairment of their fundamental rights, through acts.

","_id":"28bc3e7"},{"toggle_title":"Real Estate Fraud","toggle_content":"

There are countless types of fraud schemes - countless ways a fraudster can scam a person or a business out of money or other assets. In the case of many common fraud schemes, the crime can be internal, external, or collusion.

","_id":"9775964"},{"toggle_title":"Discrimination Case","toggle_content":"

The law which says you mustn’t be discriminated against is called the Equality Act 2010. Discrimination which is against the Act is unlawful. If you’ve experienced unlawful discrimination, you can take action about it under the Act.

When it comes to a public defender, you are talking about those that are appointed to you. There are attorneys available for hire as well. These are often good people who just want to protect those who are innocent. However, there are the few who are there to obtain money. 

Fraud Scheme

“Victims” means persons who, individually or collectively, have suffered harm, including physical or mental injury, emotional suffering, economic loss or substantial impairment of their fundamental rights, through acts.

There are countless types of fraud schemes – countless ways a fraudster can scam a person or a business out of money or other assets. In the case of many common fraud schemes, the crime can be internal, external, or collusion.

When it comes to a public defender, you are talking about those that are appointed to you. There are attorneys available for hire as well. These are often good people who just want to protect those who are innocent. However, there are the few who are there to obtain money.

","_id":"9948ec9"},{"toggle_title":"Abuse Victims","toggle_content":"

"Victims" means persons who, individually or collectively, have suffered harm, including physical or mental injury, emotional suffering, economic loss or substantial impairment of their fundamental rights, through acts.

","_id":"28bc3e7"},{"toggle_title":"Real Estate Fraud","toggle_content":"

There are countless types of fraud schemes - countless ways a fraudster can scam a person or a business out of money or other assets. In the case of many common fraud schemes, the crime can be internal, external, or collusion.

","_id":"9775964"},{"toggle_title":"Discrimination Case","toggle_content":"

The law which says you mustn’t be discriminated against is called the Equality Act 2010. Discrimination which is against the Act is unlawful. If you’ve experienced unlawful discrimination, you can take action about it under the Act.

Creative Approach to Every Project

The European languages are members of the same family. Their separate existence is a myth. For science, music, sport, etc, Europe uses the same vocabulary. The languages only differ in their grammar, their pronunciation and their most common words. Everyone realizes why a new common language would be desirable: one could refuse to pay expensive translators. To achieve this, it would be necessary to have uniform grammar, pronunciation and more common words. If several languages coalesce, the grammar of the resulting language is more simple and regular than that of the individual languages. item.content:encoded:
A passion for justice. The experience for the win.

In search of the right attorney?

We are ready to assist you in resolving any legal issues you may have.

Request Free Evaluation Welcome!

Believing in the power of law to make people’s lives better.

Who We Are
Knowledge
Knowledge
Among the strong areas of our company’s work, which we can rightfully be proud of, is the practice of family law and migration law. Read More
Diversity
Diversity
We are a team of professionals who practice migration law, practice real estate and construction, as well as criminal and judicial practice. Read More
Representation
Representation
Clients come to us based on recommendations from friends. Also we help people who found us on the Internet. Read More
Dedication
Dedication
If you need a lawyer or legal services, we are ready to help as quickly as possible. However, our priority is regular customers. Read More

Areas of Practice

Our Mission

A good attorney is what makes a difference.

You can’t pick your family, but you can choose your attorney.

Find Out More The people behind Legal Business

Meet Our Experts

View All Lawyers Testimonials

What Our Clients Say

Share Your Story

Never expected to get such a powerful theme for this little money! It's a pleasure to work with, seems it just guesses my thoughts! I was looking for a really powerful corporate theme for my website, that would allow formatting and very Diverse content representation. Now I've found it!

Daniel DawsonIT-specialist

When it became difficult to pay off loans, interest and penalties began to accumulate. The only way out was bankruptcy proceedings. They helped me a lot with this, and in six months I was able to write off all my debts. I even breathed a sigh of relief. Thank you for your help.

Harry SmithTeacher

Helped with the privatization of an apartment under a warrant. We contacted several offices for advice, but it was here that we received complete information and an action plan. They trusted me and did not regret it. Everything went professionally and quickly. I am very pleased.

Mason MillerBanker

Our Partners

Never expected to get such a powerful theme for this little money! It's a pleasure to work with, seems it just guesses my thoughts!

You can’t pick your family, but you can choose your attorney.

We are ready to assist you in resolving any legal issues you may have. Get a Free Consultation

News & Articles

Read the Blog

Committed to Helping Our Clients Succeed. Let’s Talk!

Contact Us

item.title: Contacts

item.content:encoded:
All people are equal before the law. A good attorney is what makes a difference.

Contact Information

Customer Service Enquires:
  • Email: hello@example.com
  • Phone: +1 233 456 2123
Opening Hours:
  • Monday - Thursday: 9:00 - 15:00
  • Friday: 9:00 - 14:00
  • Saturday - Sunday: Closed

All Locations

Apple Valley

Address: 14960 Florence Trail
Apple Valley, MN 55124 Get Directions Service Times: Saturdays 4 pm
Sundays 9 & 11 am

White Bear Lake

Address: 2401 East Buffalo St.
White Bear Lake, MN 55110 Get Directions Service Times: Saturdays 4 pm
Sundays 9 & 11 am

Ask a Question

If you have any questions, you can contact us. Please, fill out the form below.

item.content:encoded:
Home/No breadcrumbs

Anna Rue

The European languages are members of the same family. Their separate existence is a myth. For science, music, sport, etc, Europe uses the same vocabulary. The languages only differ in their grammar, their pronunciation and their most common words. To achieve this, it would be necessary to have uniform grammar, pronunciation.

Everyone realizes why a new common language would be desirable: one could refuse to pay expensive translators. To achieve this, it would be necessary to have uniform grammar, pronunciation.

item.title: Services
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded:
All people are equal before the law. A good attorney is what makes a difference.

Areas of Practice

We have more than 30 years of experience as trial lawyers.

Top Verdicts & Settlements

Legal support of entrepreneurial activity is the key to successful business development

$5,000,000

Spinal Cord Injury
$5,000,000 settlement for a 64 year old man who suffered a spinal cord injury and brain injury in a collision with a commercial truck.

$8,500,000

Verdict for Amputation Injury
$8,500,000 jury verdict to 37 year-old employee who lost his hand in a machine at work because his employer failed to ensure adequate safety procedures and safety guards to prevent employee injury.

$7,400,000

Accident Causing Amputation
$7,400,000 was obtained for a man who suffered crush injuries as a result of being struck by a front-end loader at an industrial facility.

$4,900,000

Medical Malpractice
$4,900,000 settlement for a patient in a case involving the misplacement of a central line into a patient’s artery instead of the vein resulting in repeated strokes that caused permanent injury.

$6,500,000

Wrongful Deaths Caused By Arson
$6,500,000 settlement for the death of ten people in an apartment arson fire due to inadequate security.

$4,875,000

Wrongful Death
$4,875,000 settlement due to the death of a 30-year-old woman who underwent an intrathecal injection and subsequently developed bacterial meningitis due to a droplet contamination.

We Work With the Best

Our Partnerships
Never expected to get such a powerful theme for this little money! It's a pleasure to work with, seems it just guesses my thoughts!

All people are equal before the law. A good attorney is what makes a difference.

Our Leadership

We have more than 30 years of experience as trial lawyers.
Who We Are?

Meet Our Experts

Share Your Story

Jane DoeEstate Planning Client

Complicated Case

When it comes to a public defender, you are talking about those that are appointed to you. There are attorneys available for hire as well. These are often good people who just want to protect those who are innocent. However, there are the few who are there to obtain money. 

Fraud Scheme

Fraud is on the rise globally: according to a 2022 PwC study, 51% of surveyed organizations experience fraud in the past two years, the highest level in 20 years of research.

 

Abuse Victims

“Victims” means persons who, individually or collectively, have suffered harm, including physical or mental injury, emotional suffering, economic loss or substantial impairment of their fundamental rights, through acts.

Real Estate Fraud

There are countless types of fraud schemes – countless ways a fraudster can scam a person or a business out of money or other assets. In the case of many common fraud schemes, the crime can be internal, external, or collusion.

Discrimination Case

The law which says you mustn’t be discriminated against is called the Equality Act 2010. Discrimination which is against the Act is unlawful. If you’ve experienced unlawful discrimination, you can take action about it under the Act.

item.title: Alexandra Sterling
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded:
Short Biography

Alexandra Sterling was born on a sunny morning on May 15th in the charming town of Charleston, South Carolina. Growing up in a family deeply rooted in the legal profession, Alexandra was exposed to discussions about justice, ethics, and the law from an early age. Her parents, both respected attorneys, instilled in her a passion for advocating for those in need. After completing her secondary education, Alexandra pursued her higher education at Yale University. There, she pursued a double major in Political Science and English Literature, immersing herself in both the study of law and the art of persuasive communication. Her academic achievements and leadership roles on campus marked her as an emerging force to be reckoned with.

Experience

Defending Catastrophic Cases
Before devoting his career to representing survivors and the families of those who were wrongfully killed, Drew worked for many years defending cases for large insurance companies and corporations, in both the United States and overseas. In that capacity, Drew litigated cases for Fortune 500 companies and eight of the top 15 largest insurance companies in the U.S.
Government and Nonprofit Work
Drew has served as private civil counsel to the Georgia Secretary of State, the Georgia Securities Commissioner, the Georgia Real Estate Commission, and the Georgia Real Estate Appraisers Board. He has served as civil counsel to Special Assistant Attorneys General, several large metro-Atlanta cities/counties, receivers in civil RICO actions, and several District Attorneys throughout Georgia. While in law school, Drew served as a legal intern with the Office of the General Counsel for the Department of Homeland Security, where he did a variety of work, including putting together cases that would strip the U.S. citizenship away from foreign citizens who were discovered to be horrific international human rights abusers. Drew also helped achieve a victory at the Supreme Court of the United States and various federal Courts of Appeals while litigating first amendment and other constitutional issues with the American Center for Law and Justice.
Education
Drew graduated from Auburn University where he obtained a Bachelor’s of Science in Finance with a concentration in Economics. He received his law degree from Regent University School of Law where he served on the Trial Advocacy Board and was an officer in the Federalist Society.
Accolades
Drew has been named both a Rising Star (an honor bestowed on only 2.5% of lawyers), and a Super Lawyer (only 5% chosen) every year since 2016. He is also listed as one of the Best Lawyers in America. He was chosen as part of the second LEAD class of the Georgia Trial Lawyers Association, where he now serves on the Executive Committee, is the Treasurer for the Civil Justice PAC Board, and is an editor and contributor to Verdict Magazine. Drew also serves as a co-chair of the Legislative Committee for the Georgia Trial Lawyer’s Association, where he is active in Georgia politics on issues affecting civil justice and the 7th Amendment right to a jury trial in civil cases. Because of Drew’s work and experience, House and Senate Subcommittees in Georgia have asked him to testify on issues involving complex personal injury laws, the laws regarding defective products, and civil justice issues generally.

item.title: Eleanor Wolfe
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded:
Short Biography

Eleanor Wolfe was born on a brisk morning on November 3rd in the vibrant city of Chicago. Raised in a family known for its strong sense of community and dedication to public service, Eleanor was inspired from a young age to make a positive impact on the world. Her parents, both educators, encouraged her to pursue her passions with unwavering determination. After completing her secondary education, Eleanor embarked on her academic journey at Stanford University. There, she pursued a dual major in Political Science and Sociology, with a minor in Human Rights. Her time at Stanford was marked by active involvement in student organizations advocating for social justice and equality.

Experience

Defending Catastrophic Cases
Before devoting his career to representing survivors and the families of those who were wrongfully killed, Drew worked for many years defending cases for large insurance companies and corporations, in both the United States and overseas. In that capacity, Drew litigated cases for Fortune 500 companies and eight of the top 15 largest insurance companies in the U.S.
Government and Nonprofit Work
Drew has served as private civil counsel to the Georgia Secretary of State, the Georgia Securities Commissioner, the Georgia Real Estate Commission, and the Georgia Real Estate Appraisers Board. He has served as civil counsel to Special Assistant Attorneys General, several large metro-Atlanta cities/counties, receivers in civil RICO actions, and several District Attorneys throughout Georgia. While in law school, Drew served as a legal intern with the Office of the General Counsel for the Department of Homeland Security, where he did a variety of work, including putting together cases that would strip the U.S. citizenship away from foreign citizens who were discovered to be horrific international human rights abusers. Drew also helped achieve a victory at the Supreme Court of the United States and various federal Courts of Appeals while litigating first amendment and other constitutional issues with the American Center for Law and Justice.
Education
Drew graduated from Auburn University where he obtained a Bachelor’s of Science in Finance with a concentration in Economics. He received his law degree from Regent University School of Law where he served on the Trial Advocacy Board and was an officer in the Federalist Society.
Accolades
Drew has been named both a Rising Star (an honor bestowed on only 2.5% of lawyers), and a Super Lawyer (only 5% chosen) every year since 2016. He is also listed as one of the Best Lawyers in America. He was chosen as part of the second LEAD class of the Georgia Trial Lawyers Association, where he now serves on the Executive Committee, is the Treasurer for the Civil Justice PAC Board, and is an editor and contributor to Verdict Magazine. Drew also serves as a co-chair of the Legislative Committee for the Georgia Trial Lawyer’s Association, where he is active in Georgia politics on issues affecting civil justice and the 7th Amendment right to a jury trial in civil cases. Because of Drew’s work and experience, House and Senate Subcommittees in Georgia have asked him to testify on issues involving complex personal injury laws, the laws regarding defective products, and civil justice issues generally.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Eleanor Wolfe's compassion and empathetic nature set her apart in the cutthroat legal world. Her ability to connect with clients on a personal level has earned her a loyal following. Behind her gentle demeanor lies a fierce advocate who fights tirelessly for the underdog.

item.title: Civil Litigation
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded:
Common Types of Civil Cases

Here are some of the most common types of civil cases:
Personal injury claims

At our law firm, we specialize in personal injury claims, working tirelessly to restore balance to your life after accidents.

Medical malpractice

We specialize in advocating for your right to proper medical treatment and seeking accountability when errors occur.

Employment disputes

We specialize in employment disputes, offering comprehensive legal support to ensure your rights are protected.

Breach of contract

Our experienced attorneys understand the intricacies of contract law and are dedicated to upholding your rights.

The Basics

What Does a Civil Litigation Attorney Do?

In summary, a civil litigation attorney is a legal professional who guides clients through the intricacies of non-criminal legal disputes.

  • Case Evaluation and Analysis
  • Legal Strategy Development
  • Preparing and Filing Documents
  • Negotiation and Settlement
  • Trial Representation
How to Apply

Do You Think You Have a Case?

Whether seeking resolution through negotiation or advocating in the courtroom, the civil litigation attorney's role is to protect their client's interests and pursue a fair and just outcome.

Get in Touch
Preferred Rewards

What Kind of Compensation Can We Recover?

Medical Expenses & Permanent Injury
Medical Expenses & Permanent Injury

Compensation can include things like medical expenses, permanent injuries, loss of employment, lost wages, property damages, and diminished earning capacity.

Loss of Employment
Loss of Employment

Losing your job can be an overwhelming experience, but you don't have to face it alone. Our team of experienced employment law attorneys understands the challenges that come with a sudden loss of employment.

Lost Wages
Lost Wages

When unforeseen circumstances lead to lost wages, the financial impact can be daunting. At our law firm, we specialize in helping individuals and families recover the compensation they deserve.

Property Damages
Property Damages

When your property suffers damage due to unforeseen events, the road to recovery can be both emotionally and financially taxing. At our law firm, we understand the significance of your property and its value to you.

Diminished Earning Capacity
Diminished Earning Capacity

Suffering an injury can lead to more than just physical pain—it can also impact your ability to earn a living. If you're facing a diminished earning capacity due to an accident, our legal team is here to help.

Non-material or Moral Damage
Non-material or Moral Damage

We recognize the significance of non-material or moral damage and the toll it can take on individuals and families. Our compassionate legal team is dedicated to helping you seek justice for the emotional harm you've experienced.

Lost Wages

When unforeseen circumstances lead to lost wages, the financial impact can be daunting. At our law firm, we specialize in helping individuals and families recover the compensation they deserve.

item.title: Estate Planning
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded:
Common Types of Civil Cases

Here are some of the most common types of civil cases:
Personal injury claims

At our law firm, we specialize in personal injury claims, working tirelessly to restore balance to your life after accidents.

Medical malpractice

We specialize in advocating for your right to proper medical treatment and seeking accountability when errors occur.

Employment disputes

We specialize in employment disputes, offering comprehensive legal support to ensure your rights are protected.

Breach of contract

Our experienced attorneys understand the intricacies of contract law and are dedicated to upholding your rights.

The Basics

What Does a Civil Litigation Attorney Do?

In summary, a civil litigation attorney is a legal professional who guides clients through the intricacies of non-criminal legal disputes.

  • Case Evaluation and Analysis
  • Legal Strategy Development
  • Preparing and Filing Documents
  • Negotiation and Settlement
  • Trial Representation
How to Apply

Do You Think You Have a Case?

Whether seeking resolution through negotiation or advocating in the courtroom, the civil litigation attorney's role is to protect their client's interests and pursue a fair and just outcome.

Get in Touch
Preferred Rewards

What Kind of Compensation Can We Recover?

Medical Expenses & Permanent Injury
Medical Expenses & Permanent Injury

Compensation can include things like medical expenses, permanent injuries, loss of employment, lost wages, property damages, and diminished earning capacity.

Loss of Employment
Loss of Employment

Losing your job can be an overwhelming experience, but you don't have to face it alone. Our team of experienced employment law attorneys understands the challenges that come with a sudden loss of employment.

Lost Wages
Lost Wages

When unforeseen circumstances lead to lost wages, the financial impact can be daunting. At our law firm, we specialize in helping individuals and families recover the compensation they deserve.

Property Damages
Property Damages

When your property suffers damage due to unforeseen events, the road to recovery can be both emotionally and financially taxing. At our law firm, we understand the significance of your property and its value to you.

Diminished Earning Capacity
Diminished Earning Capacity

Suffering an injury can lead to more than just physical pain—it can also impact your ability to earn a living. If you're facing a diminished earning capacity due to an accident, our legal team is here to help.

Non-material or Moral Damage
Non-material or Moral Damage

We recognize the significance of non-material or moral damage and the toll it can take on individuals and families. Our compassionate legal team is dedicated to helping you seek justice for the emotional harm you've experienced.

Lost Wages
Lost Wages

When unforeseen circumstances lead to lost wages, the financial impact can be daunting. At our law firm, we specialize in helping individuals and families recover the compensation they deserve.

Non-material or Moral Damage
Non-material or Moral Damage

We recognize the significance of non-material or moral damage and the toll it can take on individuals and families. Our compassionate legal team is dedicated to helping you seek justice for the emotional harm you've experienced.

item.title: Family Law and Divorce
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded:
Common Types of Civil Cases

Here are some of the most common types of civil cases:
Personal injury claims

At our law firm, we specialize in personal injury claims, working tirelessly to restore balance to your life after accidents.

Medical malpractice

We specialize in advocating for your right to proper medical treatment and seeking accountability when errors occur.

Employment disputes

We specialize in employment disputes, offering comprehensive legal support to ensure your rights are protected.

Breach of contract

Our experienced attorneys understand the intricacies of contract law and are dedicated to upholding your rights.

The Basics

What Does a Civil Litigation Attorney Do?

In summary, a civil litigation attorney is a legal professional who guides clients through the intricacies of non-criminal legal disputes.

  • Case Evaluation and Analysis
  • Legal Strategy Development
  • Preparing and Filing Documents
  • Negotiation and Settlement
  • Trial Representation
How to Apply

Do You Think You Have a Case?

Whether seeking resolution through negotiation or advocating in the courtroom, the civil litigation attorney's role is to protect their client's interests and pursue a fair and just outcome.

Get in Touch
Preferred Rewards

What Kind of Compensation Can We Recover?

Medical Expenses & Permanent Injury
Medical Expenses & Permanent Injury

Compensation can include things like medical expenses, permanent injuries, loss of employment, lost wages, property damages, and diminished earning capacity.

Loss of Employment
Loss of Employment

Losing your job can be an overwhelming experience, but you don't have to face it alone. Our team of experienced employment law attorneys understands the challenges that come with a sudden loss of employment.

Lost Wages
Lost Wages

When unforeseen circumstances lead to lost wages, the financial impact can be daunting. At our law firm, we specialize in helping individuals and families recover the compensation they deserve.

Property Damages
Property Damages

When your property suffers damage due to unforeseen events, the road to recovery can be both emotionally and financially taxing. At our law firm, we understand the significance of your property and its value to you.

Diminished Earning Capacity
Diminished Earning Capacity

Suffering an injury can lead to more than just physical pain—it can also impact your ability to earn a living. If you're facing a diminished earning capacity due to an accident, our legal team is here to help.

Non-material or Moral Damage
Non-material or Moral Damage

We recognize the significance of non-material or moral damage and the toll it can take on individuals and families. Our compassionate legal team is dedicated to helping you seek justice for the emotional harm you've experienced.

Lost Wages
Lost Wages

When unforeseen circumstances lead to lost wages, the financial impact can be daunting. At our law firm, we specialize in helping individuals and families recover the compensation they deserve.

Non-material or Moral Damage
Non-material or Moral Damage

We recognize the significance of non-material or moral damage and the toll it can take on individuals and families. Our compassionate legal team is dedicated to helping you seek justice for the emotional harm you've experienced.

item.title: Nathanial Blackwood
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded:
Short Biography

Nathanial Blackwood was born on a crisp autumn morning on October 8th in the bustling city of New York. Raised in a family that valued education and justice, his parents' influence played a significant role in shaping his future. From a young age, Nathanial displayed an unwavering curiosity and a sharp intellect. He excelled in academics, particularly drawn to literature and debate. After completing his high school education at a prestigious preparatory school, Nathanial pursued his passion for law at Harvard University. There, he earned a bachelor's degree in Political Science, graduating with honors. His time at Harvard was marked by active participation in mock trial competitions and legal seminars, where he began to forge the path to his legal career.

Experience

Defending Catastrophic Cases
Before devoting his career to representing survivors and the families of those who were wrongfully killed, Drew worked for many years defending cases for large insurance companies and corporations, in both the United States and overseas. In that capacity, Drew litigated cases for Fortune 500 companies and eight of the top 15 largest insurance companies in the U.S.
Government and Nonprofit Work
Drew has served as private civil counsel to the Georgia Secretary of State, the Georgia Securities Commissioner, the Georgia Real Estate Commission, and the Georgia Real Estate Appraisers Board. He has served as civil counsel to Special Assistant Attorneys General, several large metro-Atlanta cities/counties, receivers in civil RICO actions, and several District Attorneys throughout Georgia. While in law school, Drew served as a legal intern with the Office of the General Counsel for the Department of Homeland Security, where he did a variety of work, including putting together cases that would strip the U.S. citizenship away from foreign citizens who were discovered to be horrific international human rights abusers. Drew also helped achieve a victory at the Supreme Court of the United States and various federal Courts of Appeals while litigating first amendment and other constitutional issues with the American Center for Law and Justice.
Education
Drew graduated from Auburn University where he obtained a Bachelor’s of Science in Finance with a concentration in Economics. He received his law degree from Regent University School of Law where he served on the Trial Advocacy Board and was an officer in the Federalist Society.
Accolades
Drew has been named both a Rising Star (an honor bestowed on only 2.5% of lawyers), and a Super Lawyer (only 5% chosen) every year since 2016. He is also listed as one of the Best Lawyers in America. He was chosen as part of the second LEAD class of the Georgia Trial Lawyers Association, where he now serves on the Executive Committee, is the Treasurer for the Civil Justice PAC Board, and is an editor and contributor to Verdict Magazine. Drew also serves as a co-chair of the Legislative Committee for the Georgia Trial Lawyer’s Association, where he is active in Georgia politics on issues affecting civil justice and the 7th Amendment right to a jury trial in civil cases. Because of Drew’s work and experience, House and Senate Subcommittees in Georgia have asked him to testify on issues involving complex personal injury laws, the laws regarding defective products, and civil justice issues generally.

item.title: Dominic Archer
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded:
Short Biography

Dominic Archer was born on a warm summer day, August 12th, in the bustling city of Boston. Raised in a household where intellectual curiosity was encouraged, Dominic quickly developed a passion for learning and a keen interest in the world around him. His parents, both academics, instilled in him a strong sense of justice and the value of critical thinking. After completing his secondary education, Dominic pursued his higher studies at Princeton University. There, he majored in Philosophy with a focus on ethics and justice. His academic pursuits were complemented by his involvement in debate clubs and student organizations that championed social causes, laying the foundation for his future legal career.

Experience

Defending Catastrophic Cases
Before devoting his career to representing survivors and the families of those who were wrongfully killed, Drew worked for many years defending cases for large insurance companies and corporations, in both the United States and overseas. In that capacity, Drew litigated cases for Fortune 500 companies and eight of the top 15 largest insurance companies in the U.S.
Government and Nonprofit Work

He has served as civil counsel to Special Assistant Attorneys General, several large metro-Atlanta cities/counties, receivers in civil RICO actions, and several District Attorneys throughout Georgia. While in law school, Drew served as a legal intern with the Office of the General Counsel for the Department of Homeland Security, where he did a variety of work, including putting together cases that would strip the U.S. citizenship away from foreign citizens who were discovered to be horrific international human rights abusers. Drew also helped achieve a victory at the Supreme Court of the United States and various federal Courts of Appeals while litigating first amendment and other constitutional issues with the American Center for Law and Justice.
Education
Drew graduated from Auburn University where he obtained a Bachelor’s of Science in Finance with a concentration in Economics. He received his law degree from Regent University School of Law where he served on the Trial Advocacy Board and was an officer in the Federalist Society.
Accolades
Drew has been named both a Rising Star (an honor bestowed on only 2.5% of lawyers), and a Super Lawyer (only 5% chosen) every year since 2016. He is also listed as one of the Best Lawyers in America. He was chosen as part of the second LEAD class of the Georgia Trial Lawyers Association, where he now serves on the Executive Committee, is the Treasurer for the Civil Justice PAC Board, and is an editor and contributor to Verdict Magazine. Drew also serves as a co-chair of the Legislative Committee for the Georgia Trial Lawyer’s Association, where he is active in Georgia politics on issues affecting civil justice and the 7th Amendment right to a jury trial in civil cases. Because of Drew’s work and experience, House and Senate Subcommittees in Georgia have asked him to testify on issues involving complex personal injury laws, the laws regarding defective products, and civil justice issues generally.

item.title: Victoria Knight
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded:
Short Biography

Victoria Knight was born on a crisp winter morning, December 5th, in the picturesque town of Aspen, Colorado. Raised in a family that valued integrity and social responsibility, Victoria developed a strong sense of empathy and a commitment to making a positive impact on society. Her parents, both community activists, shaped her values from an early age. After completing her high school education, Victoria pursued her undergraduate studies at Stanford University. She majored in Political Science and minored in Women's Studies, combining her interests in law and social justice. Her time at Stanford was marked by her involvement in student-led initiatives promoting gender equality and advocating for survivors of domestic violence.

Experience

Defending Catastrophic Cases
Before devoting his career to representing survivors and the families of those who were wrongfully killed, Drew worked for many years defending cases for large insurance companies and corporations, in both the United States and overseas. In that capacity, Drew litigated cases for Fortune 500 companies and eight of the top 15 largest insurance companies in the U.S.
Government and Nonprofit Work
Drew has served as private civil counsel to the Georgia Secretary of State, the Georgia Securities Commissioner, the Georgia Real Estate Commission, and the Georgia Real Estate Appraisers Board. He has served as civil counsel to Special Assistant Attorneys General, several large metro-Atlanta cities/counties, receivers in civil RICO actions, and several District Attorneys throughout Georgia. While in law school, Drew served as a legal intern with the Office of the General Counsel for the Department of Homeland Security, where he did a variety of work, including putting together cases that would strip the U.S. citizenship away from foreign citizens who were discovered to be horrific international human rights abusers. Drew also helped achieve a victory at the Supreme Court of the United States and various federal Courts of Appeals while litigating first amendment and other constitutional issues with the American Center for Law and Justice.
Education
Drew graduated from Auburn University where he obtained a Bachelor’s of Science in Finance with a concentration in Economics. He received his law degree from Regent University School of Law where he served on the Trial Advocacy Board and was an officer in the Federalist Society.
Accolades
Drew has been named both a Rising Star (an honor bestowed on only 2.5% of lawyers), and a Super Lawyer (only 5% chosen) every year since 2016. He is also listed as one of the Best Lawyers in America. He was chosen as part of the second LEAD class of the Georgia Trial Lawyers Association, where he now serves on the Executive Committee, is the Treasurer for the Civil Justice PAC Board, and is an editor and contributor to Verdict Magazine. Drew also serves as a co-chair of the Legislative Committee for the Georgia Trial Lawyer’s Association, where he is active in Georgia politics on issues affecting civil justice and the 7th Amendment right to a jury trial in civil cases. Because of Drew’s work and experience, House and Senate Subcommittees in Georgia have asked him to testify on issues involving complex personal injury laws, the laws regarding defective products, and civil justice issues generally.

item.title: Oliver Quinn
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded:
Short Biography

Oliver Quinn was born on a sunny spring morning, April 20th, in the vibrant city of San Francisco, California. Growing up in a diverse neighborhood, Oliver was exposed to various cultures and perspectives from an early age. His parents, both educators with a strong sense of social justice, instilled in him a deep appreciation for learning and a commitment to making a positive impact. After completing his secondary education, Oliver pursued his academic journey at the University of California, Berkeley. He chose to major in Political Science and minored in Environmental Studies, driven by a desire to understand the intersection of law and environmental sustainability. During his time at Berkeley, he engaged in student-led initiatives focused on environmental activism and advocacy.

Experience

Defending Catastrophic Cases
Before devoting his career to representing survivors and the families of those who were wrongfully killed, Drew worked for many years defending cases for large insurance companies and corporations, in both the United States and overseas. In that capacity, Drew litigated cases for Fortune 500 companies and eight of the top 15 largest insurance companies in the U.S.
Government and Nonprofit Work
Drew has served as private civil counsel to the Georgia Secretary of State, the Georgia Securities Commissioner, the Georgia Real Estate Commission, and the Georgia Real Estate Appraisers Board. He has served as civil counsel to Special Assistant Attorneys General, several large metro-Atlanta cities/counties, receivers in civil RICO actions, and several District Attorneys throughout Georgia. While in law school, Drew served as a legal intern with the Office of the General Counsel for the Department of Homeland Security, where he did a variety of work, including putting together cases that would strip the U.S. citizenship away from foreign citizens who were discovered to be horrific international human rights abusers. Drew also helped achieve a victory at the Supreme Court of the United States and various federal Courts of Appeals while litigating first amendment and other constitutional issues with the American Center for Law and Justice.
Education
Drew graduated from Auburn University where he obtained a Bachelor’s of Science in Finance with a concentration in Economics. He received his law degree from Regent University School of Law where he served on the Trial Advocacy Board and was an officer in the Federalist Society.
Accolades
Drew has been named both a Rising Star (an honor bestowed on only 2.5% of lawyers), and a Super Lawyer (only 5% chosen) every year since 2016. He is also listed as one of the Best Lawyers in America. He was chosen as part of the second LEAD class of the Georgia Trial Lawyers Association, where he now serves on the Executive Committee, is the Treasurer for the Civil Justice PAC Board, and is an editor and contributor to Verdict Magazine. Drew also serves as a co-chair of the Legislative Committee for the Georgia Trial Lawyer’s Association, where he is active in Georgia politics on issues affecting civil justice and the 7th Amendment right to a jury trial in civil cases. Because of Drew’s work and experience, House and Senate Subcommittees in Georgia have asked him to testify on issues involving complex personal injury laws, the laws regarding defective products, and civil justice issues generally.

item.title: Isabella Cruz
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded:
Short Biography

Isabella Cruz was born on a warm summer day, July 8th, in the bustling city of Miami, Florida. Growing up in a tight-knit immigrant family, Isabella learned the values of hard work, determination, and the importance of cultural heritage. Her parents, who had emigrated from Latin America, instilled in her a strong sense of identity and the drive to succeed. After completing her high school education, Isabella pursued her academic journey at the University of Miami. There, she pursued a dual major in Law and International Relations, with a focus on human rights and diplomacy. She actively participated in student organizations advocating for immigrant rights and social justice, cementing her commitment to making a positive impact on society.

Experience

Defending Catastrophic Cases
Before devoting his career to representing survivors and the families of those who were wrongfully killed, Drew worked for many years defending cases for large insurance companies and corporations, in both the United States and overseas. In that capacity, Drew litigated cases for Fortune 500 companies and eight of the top 15 largest insurance companies in the U.S.
Government and Nonprofit Work
Drew has served as private civil counsel to the Georgia Secretary of State, the Georgia Securities Commissioner, the Georgia Real Estate Commission, and the Georgia Real Estate Appraisers Board. He has served as civil counsel to Special Assistant Attorneys General, several large metro-Atlanta cities/counties, receivers in civil RICO actions, and several District Attorneys throughout Georgia. While in law school, Drew served as a legal intern with the Office of the General Counsel for the Department of Homeland Security, where he did a variety of work, including putting together cases that would strip the U.S. citizenship away from foreign citizens who were discovered to be horrific international human rights abusers. Drew also helped achieve a victory at the Supreme Court of the United States and various federal Courts of Appeals while litigating first amendment and other constitutional issues with the American Center for Law and Justice.
Education
Drew graduated from Auburn University where he obtained a Bachelor’s of Science in Finance with a concentration in Economics. He received his law degree from Regent University School of Law where he served on the Trial Advocacy Board and was an officer in the Federalist Society.
Accolades
Drew has been named both a Rising Star (an honor bestowed on only 2.5% of lawyers), and a Super Lawyer (only 5% chosen) every year since 2016. He is also listed as one of the Best Lawyers in America. He was chosen as part of the second LEAD class of the Georgia Trial Lawyers Association, where he now serves on the Executive Committee, is the Treasurer for the Civil Justice PAC Board, and is an editor and contributor to Verdict Magazine. Drew also serves as a co-chair of the Legislative Committee for the Georgia Trial Lawyer’s Association, where he is active in Georgia politics on issues affecting civil justice and the 7th Amendment right to a jury trial in civil cases. Because of Drew’s work and experience, House and Senate Subcommittees in Georgia have asked him to testify on issues involving complex personal injury laws, the laws regarding defective products, and civil justice issues generally.

item.title: Maxwell Frost
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded:
Short Biography

Maxwell Frost was born on a crisp autumn day, October 18th, in the heart of New England, Boston, Massachusetts. Raised in a family that valued education, integrity, and public service, Maxwell's childhood was characterized by discussions of justice and the importance of making a positive impact on society. His parents, both educators, instilled in him a strong sense of curiosity and a love for learning. After completing his secondary education, Maxwell pursued his higher studies at Yale University. He pursued a double major in Political Science and History, immersing himself in the intricacies of governance, policy, and the evolution of legal systems. During his time at Yale, he participated in debates, volunteered at local legal clinics, and further solidified his commitment to pursuing a legal career.

Experience

Defending Catastrophic Cases
Before devoting his career to representing survivors and the families of those who were wrongfully killed, Drew worked for many years defending cases for large insurance companies and corporations, in both the United States and overseas. In that capacity, Drew litigated cases for Fortune 500 companies and eight of the top 15 largest insurance companies in the U.S.
Government and Nonprofit Work
Drew has served as private civil counsel to the Georgia Secretary of State, the Georgia Securities Commissioner, the Georgia Real Estate Commission, and the Georgia Real Estate Appraisers Board. He has served as civil counsel to Special Assistant Attorneys General, several large metro-Atlanta cities/counties, receivers in civil RICO actions, and several District Attorneys throughout Georgia. While in law school, Drew served as a legal intern with the Office of the General Counsel for the Department of Homeland Security, where he did a variety of work, including putting together cases that would strip the U.S. citizenship away from foreign citizens who were discovered to be horrific international human rights abusers. Drew also helped achieve a victory at the Supreme Court of the United States and various federal Courts of Appeals while litigating first amendment and other constitutional issues with the American Center for Law and Justice.
Education
Drew graduated from Auburn University where he obtained a Bachelor’s of Science in Finance with a concentration in Economics. He received his law degree from Regent University School of Law where he served on the Trial Advocacy Board and was an officer in the Federalist Society.
Accolades
Drew has been named both a Rising Star (an honor bestowed on only 2.5% of lawyers), and a Super Lawyer (only 5% chosen) every year since 2016. He is also listed as one of the Best Lawyers in America. He was chosen as part of the second LEAD class of the Georgia Trial Lawyers Association, where he now serves on the Executive Committee, is the Treasurer for the Civil Justice PAC Board, and is an editor and contributor to Verdict Magazine. Drew also serves as a co-chair of the Legislative Committee for the Georgia Trial Lawyer’s Association, where he is active in Georgia politics on issues affecting civil justice and the 7th Amendment right to a jury trial in civil cases. Because of Drew’s work and experience, House and Senate Subcommittees in Georgia have asked him to testify on issues involving complex personal injury laws, the laws regarding defective products, and civil justice issues generally.

Drew also helped achieve a victory at the Supreme Court of the United States and various federal Courts of Appeals while litigating first amendment and other constitutional issues with the American Center for Law and Justice.","cmsmasters_ribbon_title":"New"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"},{"id":"22c6c18","elType":"widget","settings":{"text":"Divider","gap":{"unit":"px","size":0,"sizes":[]},"_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"20","right":"0","bottom":"20","left":"0","isLinked":false},"cmsmasters_ribbon_title":"New","__globals__":{"color":"globals/colors?id=border"}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"divider"},{"id":"21492c8","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"Education","header_size":"h5","cmsmasters_ribbon_title":"New"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"heading"},{"id":"412a462","elType":"widget","settings":{"editor":"Drew graduated from Auburn University where he obtained a Bachelor’s of Science in Finance with a concentration in Economics. He received his law degree from Regent University School of Law where he served on the Trial Advocacy Board and was an officer in the Federalist Society.","cmsmasters_ribbon_title":"New"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"},{"id":"db9fea3","elType":"widget","settings":{"text":"Divider","gap":{"unit":"px","size":0,"sizes":[]},"_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"20","right":"0","bottom":"20","left":"0","isLinked":false},"cmsmasters_ribbon_title":"New","__globals__":{"color":"globals/colors?id=border"}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"divider"},{"id":"e8ce698","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"Accolades","header_size":"h5","cmsmasters_ribbon_title":"New"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"heading"},{"id":"4568bd6","elType":"widget","settings":{"editor":"Drew has been named both a Rising Star (an honor bestowed on only 2.5% of lawyers), and a Super Lawyer (only 5% chosen) every year since 2016. He is also listed as one of the Best Lawyers in America. He was chosen as part of the second LEAD class of the Georgia Trial Lawyers Association, where he now serves on the Executive Committee, is the Treasurer for the Civil Justice PAC Board, and is an editor and contributor to Verdict Magazine. Drew also serves as a co-chair of the Legislative Committee for the Georgia Trial Lawyer’s Association, where he is active in Georgia politics on issues affecting civil justice and the 7th Amendment right to a jury trial in civil cases.

Because of Drew’s work and experience, House and Senate Subcommittees in Georgia have asked him to testify on issues involving complex personal injury laws, the laws regarding defective products, and civil justice issues generally.","cmsmasters_ribbon_title":"New"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false}]

Common Types of Civil Cases

Here are some of the most common types of civil cases:
Personal injury claims

At our law firm, we specialize in personal injury claims, working tirelessly to restore balance to your life after accidents.

Medical malpractice

We specialize in advocating for your right to proper medical treatment and seeking accountability when errors occur.

Employment disputes

We specialize in employment disputes, offering comprehensive legal support to ensure your rights are protected.

Breach of contract

Our experienced attorneys understand the intricacies of contract law and are dedicated to upholding your rights.

The Basics

What Does a Civil Litigation Attorney Do?

In summary, a civil litigation attorney is a legal professional who guides clients through the intricacies of non-criminal legal disputes.

  • Case Evaluation and Analysis
  • Legal Strategy Development
  • Preparing and Filing Documents
  • Negotiation and Settlement
  • Trial Representation
How to Apply

Do You Think You Have a Case?

Whether seeking resolution through negotiation or advocating in the courtroom, the civil litigation attorney's role is to protect their client's interests and pursue a fair and just outcome.

Get in Touch
Preferred Rewards

What Kind of Compensation Can We Recover?

Medical Expenses & Permanent Injury
Medical Expenses & Permanent Injury

Compensation can include things like medical expenses, permanent injuries, loss of employment, lost wages, property damages, and diminished earning capacity.

Loss of Employment
Loss of Employment

Losing your job can be an overwhelming experience, but you don't have to face it alone. Our team of experienced employment law attorneys understands the challenges that come with a sudden loss of employment.

Lost Wages
Lost Wages

When unforeseen circumstances lead to lost wages, the financial impact can be daunting. At our law firm, we specialize in helping individuals and families recover the compensation they deserve.

Property Damages
Property Damages

When your property suffers damage due to unforeseen events, the road to recovery can be both emotionally and financially taxing. At our law firm, we understand the significance of your property and its value to you.

Diminished Earning Capacity
Diminished Earning Capacity

Suffering an injury can lead to more than just physical pain—it can also impact your ability to earn a living. If you're facing a diminished earning capacity due to an accident, our legal team is here to help.

Non-material or Moral Damage
Non-material or Moral Damage

We recognize the significance of non-material or moral damage and the toll it can take on individuals and families. Our compassionate legal team is dedicated to helping you seek justice for the emotional harm you've experienced.

Lost Wages
Lost Wages

When unforeseen circumstances lead to lost wages, the financial impact can be daunting. At our law firm, we specialize in helping individuals and families recover the compensation they deserve.

item.title: Personal Injury Claims
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded:
Common Types of Civil Cases

Here are some of the most common types of civil cases:
Personal injury claims

At our law firm, we specialize in personal injury claims, working tirelessly to restore balance to your life after accidents.

Medical malpractice

We specialize in advocating for your right to proper medical treatment and seeking accountability when errors occur.

Employment disputes

We specialize in employment disputes, offering comprehensive legal support to ensure your rights are protected.

Breach of contract

Our experienced attorneys understand the intricacies of contract law and are dedicated to upholding your rights.

The Basics

What Does a Civil Litigation Attorney Do?

In summary, a civil litigation attorney is a legal professional who guides clients through the intricacies of non-criminal legal disputes.

  • Case Evaluation and Analysis
  • Legal Strategy Development
  • Preparing and Filing Documents
  • Negotiation and Settlement
  • Trial Representation
How to Apply

Do You Think You Have a Case?

Whether seeking resolution through negotiation or advocating in the courtroom, the civil litigation attorney's role is to protect their client's interests and pursue a fair and just outcome.

Get in Touch
Preferred Rewards

What Kind of Compensation Can We Recover?

Medical Expenses & Permanent Injury
Medical Expenses & Permanent Injury

Compensation can include things like medical expenses, permanent injuries, loss of employment, lost wages, property damages, and diminished earning capacity.

Loss of Employment
Loss of Employment

Losing your job can be an overwhelming experience, but you don't have to face it alone. Our team of experienced employment law attorneys understands the challenges that come with a sudden loss of employment.

Lost Wages
Lost Wages

When unforeseen circumstances lead to lost wages, the financial impact can be daunting. At our law firm, we specialize in helping individuals and families recover the compensation they deserve.

Property Damages
Property Damages

When your property suffers damage due to unforeseen events, the road to recovery can be both emotionally and financially taxing. At our law firm, we understand the significance of your property and its value to you.

Diminished Earning Capacity
Diminished Earning Capacity

Suffering an injury can lead to more than just physical pain—it can also impact your ability to earn a living. If you're facing a diminished earning capacity due to an accident, our legal team is here to help.

Non-material or Moral Damage
Non-material or Moral Damage

We recognize the significance of non-material or moral damage and the toll it can take on individuals and families. Our compassionate legal team is dedicated to helping you seek justice for the emotional harm you've experienced.

Lost Wages
Lost Wages

When unforeseen circumstances lead to lost wages, the financial impact can be daunting. At our law firm, we specialize in helping individuals and families recover the compensation they deserve.

Non-material or Moral Damage
Non-material or Moral Damage

We recognize the significance of non-material or moral damage and the toll it can take on individuals and families. Our compassionate legal team is dedicated to helping you seek justice for the emotional harm you've experienced.

item.title: Immigration Services
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded:
Common Types of Civil Cases

Here are some of the most common types of civil cases:
Personal injury claims

At our law firm, we specialize in personal injury claims, working tirelessly to restore balance to your life after accidents.

Medical malpractice

We specialize in advocating for your right to proper medical treatment and seeking accountability when errors occur.

Employment disputes

We specialize in employment disputes, offering comprehensive legal support to ensure your rights are protected.

Breach of contract

Our experienced attorneys understand the intricacies of contract law and are dedicated to upholding your rights.

The Basics

What Does a Civil Litigation Attorney Do?

In summary, a civil litigation attorney is a legal professional who guides clients through the intricacies of non-criminal legal disputes.

  • Case Evaluation and Analysis
  • Legal Strategy Development
  • Preparing and Filing Documents
  • Negotiation and Settlement
  • Trial Representation
How to Apply

Do You Think You Have a Case?

Whether seeking resolution through negotiation or advocating in the courtroom, the civil litigation attorney's role is to protect their client's interests and pursue a fair and just outcome.

Get in Touch
Preferred Rewards

What Kind of Compensation Can We Recover?

Medical Expenses & Permanent Injury
Medical Expenses & Permanent Injury

Compensation can include things like medical expenses, permanent injuries, loss of employment, lost wages, property damages, and diminished earning capacity.

Loss of Employment
Loss of Employment

Losing your job can be an overwhelming experience, but you don't have to face it alone. Our team of experienced employment law attorneys understands the challenges that come with a sudden loss of employment.

Lost Wages
Lost Wages

When unforeseen circumstances lead to lost wages, the financial impact can be daunting. At our law firm, we specialize in helping individuals and families recover the compensation they deserve.

Property Damages
Property Damages

When your property suffers damage due to unforeseen events, the road to recovery can be both emotionally and financially taxing. At our law firm, we understand the significance of your property and its value to you.

Diminished Earning Capacity
Diminished Earning Capacity

Suffering an injury can lead to more than just physical pain—it can also impact your ability to earn a living. If you're facing a diminished earning capacity due to an accident, our legal team is here to help.

Non-material or Moral Damage
Non-material or Moral Damage

We recognize the significance of non-material or moral damage and the toll it can take on individuals and families. Our compassionate legal team is dedicated to helping you seek justice for the emotional harm you've experienced.

Lost Wages
Lost Wages

When unforeseen circumstances lead to lost wages, the financial impact can be daunting. At our law firm, we specialize in helping individuals and families recover the compensation they deserve.

Non-material or Moral Damage
Non-material or Moral Damage

We recognize the significance of non-material or moral damage and the toll it can take on individuals and families. Our compassionate legal team is dedicated to helping you seek justice for the emotional harm you've experienced.

item.title: Criminal Defense
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded:
Common Types of Civil Cases

Here are some of the most common types of civil cases:
Personal injury claims

At our law firm, we specialize in personal injury claims, working tirelessly to restore balance to your life after accidents.

Medical malpractice

We specialize in advocating for your right to proper medical treatment and seeking accountability when errors occur.

Employment disputes

We specialize in employment disputes, offering comprehensive legal support to ensure your rights are protected.

Breach of contract

Our experienced attorneys understand the intricacies of contract law and are dedicated to upholding your rights.

The Basics

What Does a Civil Litigation Attorney Do?

In summary, a civil litigation attorney is a legal professional who guides clients through the intricacies of non-criminal legal disputes.

  • Case Evaluation and Analysis
  • Legal Strategy Development
  • Preparing and Filing Documents
  • Negotiation and Settlement
  • Trial Representation
How to Apply

Do You Think You Have a Case?

Whether seeking resolution through negotiation or advocating in the courtroom, the civil litigation attorney's role is to protect their client's interests and pursue a fair and just outcome.

Get in Touch
Preferred Rewards

What Kind of Compensation Can We Recover?

Medical Expenses & Permanent Injury
Medical Expenses & Permanent Injury

Compensation can include things like medical expenses, permanent injuries, loss of employment, lost wages, property damages, and diminished earning capacity.

Loss of Employment
Loss of Employment

Losing your job can be an overwhelming experience, but you don't have to face it alone. Our team of experienced employment law attorneys understands the challenges that come with a sudden loss of employment.

Lost Wages
Lost Wages

When unforeseen circumstances lead to lost wages, the financial impact can be daunting. At our law firm, we specialize in helping individuals and families recover the compensation they deserve.

Property Damages
Property Damages

When your property suffers damage due to unforeseen events, the road to recovery can be both emotionally and financially taxing. At our law firm, we understand the significance of your property and its value to you.

Diminished Earning Capacity
Diminished Earning Capacity

Suffering an injury can lead to more than just physical pain—it can also impact your ability to earn a living. If you're facing a diminished earning capacity due to an accident, our legal team is here to help.

Non-material or Moral Damage
Non-material or Moral Damage

We recognize the significance of non-material or moral damage and the toll it can take on individuals and families. Our compassionate legal team is dedicated to helping you seek justice for the emotional harm you've experienced.

Lost Wages
Lost Wages

When unforeseen circumstances lead to lost wages, the financial impact can be daunting. At our law firm, we specialize in helping individuals and families recover the compensation they deserve.

Non-material or Moral Damage
Non-material or Moral Damage

We recognize the significance of non-material or moral damage and the toll it can take on individuals and families. Our compassionate legal team is dedicated to helping you seek justice for the emotional harm you've experienced.

item.title: Discrimination Claims
item.dc:creator: cmsmasters
item.content:encoded:
Common Types of Civil Cases

Here are some of the most common types of civil cases:
Personal injury claims

At our law firm, we specialize in personal injury claims, working tirelessly to restore balance to your life after accidents.

Medical malpractice

We specialize in advocating for your right to proper medical treatment and seeking accountability when errors occur.

Employment disputes

We specialize in employment disputes, offering comprehensive legal support to ensure your rights are protected.

Breach of contract

Our experienced attorneys understand the intricacies of contract law and are dedicated to upholding your rights.

The Basics

What Does a Civil Litigation Attorney Do?

In summary, a civil litigation attorney is a legal professional who guides clients through the intricacies of non-criminal legal disputes.

  • Case Evaluation and Analysis
  • Legal Strategy Development
  • Preparing and Filing Documents
  • Negotiation and Settlement
  • Trial Representation
How to Apply

Do You Think You Have a Case?

Whether seeking resolution through negotiation or advocating in the courtroom, the civil litigation attorney's role is to protect their client's interests and pursue a fair and just outcome.

Get in Touch
Preferred Rewards

What Kind of Compensation Can We Recover?

Medical Expenses & Permanent Injury
Medical Expenses & Permanent Injury

Compensation can include things like medical expenses, permanent injuries, loss of employment, lost wages, property damages, and diminished earning capacity.

Loss of Employment
Loss of Employment

Losing your job can be an overwhelming experience, but you don't have to face it alone. Our team of experienced employment law attorneys understands the challenges that come with a sudden loss of employment.

Lost Wages
Lost Wages

When unforeseen circumstances lead to lost wages, the financial impact can be daunting. At our law firm, we specialize in helping individuals and families recover the compensation they deserve.

Property Damages
Property Damages

When your property suffers damage due to unforeseen events, the road to recovery can be both emotionally and financially taxing. At our law firm, we understand the significance of your property and its value to you.

Diminished Earning Capacity
Diminished Earning Capacity

Suffering an injury can lead to more than just physical pain—it can also impact your ability to earn a living. If you're facing a diminished earning capacity due to an accident, our legal team is here to help.

Non-material or Moral Damage
Non-material or Moral Damage

We recognize the significance of non-material or moral damage and the toll it can take on individuals and families. Our compassionate legal team is dedicated to helping you seek justice for the emotional harm you've experienced.

Lost Wages
Lost Wages

When unforeseen circumstances lead to lost wages, the financial impact can be daunting. At our law firm, we specialize in helping individuals and families recover the compensation they deserve.

Non-material or Moral Damage
Non-material or Moral Damage

We recognize the significance of non-material or moral damage and the toll it can take on individuals and families. Our compassionate legal team is dedicated to helping you seek justice for the emotional harm you've experienced.
